turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi. What would I need to give you if I wanted to apply?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Every applicant needs ID, proof of address, payslips, a reference from their current landlord and one from their employer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Right. I've just started a new job so the employer reference might take a week or so.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine. Would you like to see the flat in the meantime, or wait until you have the documents together?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll wait, then I'll ring you back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. When you're ready, call the office and ask for a viewing of the Elm Road two bedroom. Thanks for your time.
